100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic
224
